title: ContainerConfig
description: How a project's agent containers and their jobs run (ADR 0061). The researcher's: no agent route reads or writes it.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

image.description: The image agent and job containers run (glibc, a shell, Git, CA certificates). AblationKit's own is built by `ablationkit agent image build`.

agent.title: ContainerAgentLimits
agent.description: The agent container's own limits (kernel-enforced by its cgroup). It has no GPU.

mode.description: `allowlist`: only `allow` and the harness's own hosts. `open`: any host, every connection still recorded.

allow.description: Hosts the agent container (and jobs with `jobs.network: egress`) may reach. Package indexes belong in `environment.allow` (ADR 0066).

items.title: HostPattern
items.description: An egress allowlist entry: `example.com` (that host, ports 80 and 443), `*.example.com` (its subdomains, not the host itself), either with `:port` for one other port, or `*` (any host: the same as egress mode `open`).

environment.title: ContainerEnvironmentConfig
environment.description: The project's environment builds (ADR 0066): `uv sync` in a job container of its own, the only place agents' packages are installed. Absent: AblationKit's defaults.

allow.description: Hosts an environment build may reach: package indexes, Python downloads, Git dependencies.

items.title: HostPattern
items.description: An egress allowlist entry: `example.com` (that host, ports 80 and 443), `*.example.com` (its subdomains, not the host itself), either with `:port` for one other port, or `*` (any host: the same as egress mode `open`).

hidden.description: Paths neither the agent container nor an ordinary job container can see (held-out data, evaluation code). Inside the checkout the working tree is hidden, not Git history: keep protected files out of the repository.

items.description: An absolute path on this machine, or a path relative to the checkout (no `..` segments: checked in code).

read_only.description: Checkout paths the agent container can read but not change.

items.description: A path relative to the checkout (no `..` segments: checked in code).

gpu.description: `all`: every GPU the CDI spec names (`nvidia.com/gpu=all`).

network.description: `none`: no network at all (the environment is built beforehand by an environment build, ADR 0066). `egress`: the egress allowlist through the attempt's own proxy.

items.title: ContainerEvaluation
items.description: A protected evaluation (ADR 0061, after ADR 0033): the researcher pins its command and the hidden data it reads; a contained agent can run it (`evaluation` on job submit) but never read its data, its console or its command's source when that is hidden.

command.description: argv, pinned by the researcher. Run from `cwd` in the checkout against the agent's current code, in a job container with the evaluation's `mounts` read-only and no network.

cwd.description: A path relative to the checkout (no `..` segments: checked in code).

mounts.description: Hidden paths (from the config's `hidden`) this evaluation reads, mounted read-only into its job container only.

items.description: An absolute path on this machine, or a path relative to the checkout (no `..` segments: checked in code).

items.title: ContainerCredential
items.description: A credential the egress proxy adds to requests, so the secret never enters the container: the container calls `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<name>/…` and the proxy forwards it to `upstream` with the header set.

header.description: The header the secret is sent in, e.g. `authorization` or `x-api-key`.

from_env.description: The coordinator's environment variable holding the secret.

from_file.description: A file on this machine holding the secret (its first line).

env.description: Environment variables set in the agent container, with `{url}` replaced by this credential's route inside the container (e.g. `HF_ENDPOINT: {url}`). Names are checked in code.

host_code.description: Agent operations that run project code on this machine outside a container (extension builds and runs): `refuse` for contained sessions, or `allow` them.

pause_on_compute_limit.description: Freeze a contained session when the compute limit refuses its job; the researcher resumes it.
